**Triage: lands in `packages/drivers/driver-memory`; `domain:engine`; `priority:p2`. ⚠️ #5499 freeze fence applies — and read the card's disposition section FIRST.**

On `driver-memory`, **a time-triggered flow that touches per-organization data has NO legal configuration** — PR #17334 moves it **from the served case into the refused one**.

⭐ **The filer's instruction is adopted verbatim and is the first thing the taker must do:** *"A dedup search found a standing maintainer ruling that almost certainly decides this card without anyone re-deciding anything, and it is the reason this was not filed into the decision box."* ⇒ **read that ruling first.** If it decides the shape, this is execution; if it does not, ⛔ **stop and report** and the card goes to the decision box rather than being decided in a PR.

⭐ The measurement is properly grounded: the at-tier review of PR #17334 found the changeset banner's claim — a single-organization install *"loses nothing at run time"* — **false**, verified by running **the driver's own exported predicate** `assertCallNotTenantScoped` (`memory-tenancy-guard.ts:303`) over **all twelve doors it guards**. ⛔ Not read off a docblock.

⚠️ **First premise: check whether PR #17334 has merged.** If it has, the refusal is live on `main` today and the card is a regression report; if it has not, this is a pre-landing warning and the cheaper fix may be in that PR. Say which you found.

### ⚠️ ⛔ Investment-freeze fence

`driver-memory` production code is under **#5499's freeze** — the same fence as #17301, #17348 and #17286. ⇒ qualify under its 例外升级通道 and **cite the clause**, or ⛔ stop and report. ⭐ Four cards now sit behind that one question; settling it once serves all four.

`Size/model suggestion:` M.

## Retriage answer — **dissent upheld. The exception call is triage's, and I am making it: NOT escalated.** `pm:queue` → **`pm:on-hold`** referencing #5499; `pm:retriage` stripped.

⭐ **The dissent is exactly right and the distinction is a fine one worth stating.** Triage did name #5499 and did fence each of these four. But naming a freeze while leaving the card in `pm:queue` leaves the **exception decision** to whoever picks it up — and #5499 puts that decision with the triage round by name:

> **例外升级通道**:若 driver-memory 的缺陷影响 CI 判绿的正确性(单测后端语义错造成测试假绿/假红),按 restore-invariant 处理,**由分诊轮点名升级**,不受本冻结约束;

and the default is unambiguous:

> **新单分诊规则(常设)**:driver-memory / driver-mongodb 族新单照常按落点打 `domain:engine`,但**直接挂 `pm:on-hold` 引用本单,不入 `pm:queue`**。

⇒ ⛔ A fenced `pm:queue` card is not a weaker hold; it is **the call not made**. Making it now.

## The exception test, answered: **NO escalation owed** — and the filing seat had already done this work

⭐ The card checked the exception channel itself and measured the answer. I am confirming its reasoning, ⛔ not re-deriving it:

> PR #17334's own dogfood test (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/schedule-sweep-organization-scope.dogfood.test.ts`) runs the `memory` leg and **asserts the refusal**, with a paired control proving the refusal is about the scope and not about the fixture. So the semantics are **pinned, not silently wrong: no false green, no false red.**

⇒ The first limb of the exception fails. ⛔ No escalation.

⭐ **And the card was right not to file this in the decision box**: the implementing round offered A/B/C and recommended A, and **#5499 already IS option A for the whole component** — the direction is replacement by sqlite `:memory:`, not extension. Filing it would have asked the maintainer to re-decide something decided five weeks ago.

⚠️ The card offered triage one way to disagree — that the *flow-kind × driver support matrix* is a separate axis from the component freeze. ⛔ **I do not take it.** A flow kind that cannot be served by a component being retired needs no fix, only the retirement; #5499's own batch-close disposes of this correctly.

## ⚠️ The `Restart-when:` line, and the trap I nearly walked into

`pm:on-hold` is legal **only** with a machine-readable `Restart-when:` line — either `closed <owner/repo>#N` or a one-line executable criterion.

⛔ **`Restart-when: closed #5499` would be illegal in substance**, and this seat routed the card that says why two fires ago: **#5499 carries `tracking`** and is a cross-card anchor that **stays open by design**. ⇒ That spelling passes H9's presence test and **can never fire** — precisely the class **#17377** documents (「an unreachable `closed …#N` — a `tracking` anchor that stays open by design」).

⇒ Used the executable form instead, keyed to #5499's **own** stated wake condition (「when the sqlite `:memory:` replacement is complete on the test surface, the cards hung under it are closed **not planned** as a batch」):

```
Restart-when: `git grep -l 'driver-memory\|InMemoryDriver' origin/main -- packages/qa/ .github/workflows/` returns 0
```

⚠️ Measured now: it returns **6** (`ci.yml`, `lint.yml`, `rerun-safety-nightly.yml`, and three `packages/qa/dogfood/test/*`). ⇒ The criterion is meaningful today and not already satisfied.

⚠️ **A structural gap this exposed is filed separately**: the sole pre-existing hold under #5499 (**#14082**) carries **no `Restart-when:` line at all**, and no card exists for the replacement work the freeze names as its wake. ⇒ Every card held under this freeze is currently either illegal or unfireable.

## 关 `not_planned` —— 维护者逐张复核 on-hold 卡时同意关闭;#5499 已经是整个组件的选项 A

分诊席(`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`),2026-09-23T11:08Z。维护者 2026-09-23 在分诊会话里逐张复核 `pm:on-hold` 卡,对第八组的回复原文:「其他同意」。本卡在那一组里的建议是关闭。

### 事实,原样记录

在 `driver-memory` 上,一个处理**分组织数据**的定时流程**没有合法配置**:声明组织 ⇒ 每次数据调用带 `tenantId` ⇒ 12 个入口全部拒绝(`MEMORY_MULTI_TENANT_UNSUPPORTED`);不声明 ⇒ 流程根本不被挂上(PR #17334 的绑定期那一半)。唯一被服务的配置(把对象声明为平台全局)恰恰是守卫自己的拒绝信息说不能用在真正分组织的数据上的那一种。PR #17334 没有制造这个限制,它只是把定时流程从「被服务」挪到了「被拒绝」,而且 dogfood 测试把拒绝钉住了 —— 没有假绿、没有假红。

### 为什么关

- #5499(维护者 2026-08-05)对 `driver-memory` 定的方向是**用 sqlite 内存模式替代,不是扩展**;这正是实现轮给出的选项 A(声明内存驱动不支持这类定时数据流程),只不过是对整个组件而言。
- 新项目默认走 `driver-sql` 上的持久 sqlite(`packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` 的数据库解析),不是内存驱动 ⇒ 新开发者按正常路径不会撞上。
- 今天同一族的 #14082、#15104、#17301 同样按这个理由关闭。

### ⚠️ 必须带给以后替代工作的一句话

本卡描述的**不是**内存驱动的缺陷,而是「这个驱动能服务哪几种流程」。**如果 sqlite 内存模式替代上线时同样没有行级租户隔离,这个缺口会原样跟过去。** ⇒ 做替代的人要检查继任者的租户守卫,⛔ 不能只看旧组件是否已移除。

### 重开条件

sqlite 内存模式的替代落地,而继任者在「定时流程 × 分组织数据」上仍然没有合法配置 ⇒ 带着继任者的实测重开或另立新卡。

**关闭理由:`not_planned`**,同时摘掉 `pm:on-hold`。
